text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Nishino Flower! That was awesome!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Everyone! This is my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer's the absolute best and has been running alongside me this entire time!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Let's hear it for the best trainer ever!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sorry. But I've always wanted to do this. I want everyone to know…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That you're the best trainer there is!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Was I able to fully bloom?
choice_data_list: Of course! You were the most beautiful blossom out there!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My own blossoming wasn't up to par!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: But congratulations! Your speed was exemplary—no, it was perfect!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to repay you… but I was able to watch you run.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind I yearned after for so long—now, I can chase it. No, I can surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Best of luck to you too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Mm. I can smell it upon the breeze… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The future… is coming.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Nishino Flower! Could you and your trainer tell us about how you feel about your win today?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And this is where I shall excuse myself…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you again, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we finish taking interviews at the winner's circle…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Great job today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You looked so cool giving those interviews! Your posture was super straight and everything!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It made me think all the hard work I put in up till now was just so I could see you looking as proud as you did up there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's not true. It's all because of how hard you worked!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmm… How about we say it's thanks to the both of us, then?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Let's keep running together, all the way into the future!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I was only able to bloom as beautifully as I did because of how carefully you guided, trained, and cared for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for all of your support… and all the courage you gave me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad we met! ♪
